title: Flying the Q-180 from South Bay to Eastmere
body: We flew the Q-180 from South Bay to Eastmere. The new cut follows the takeoff from runway level, then shows the Q-180 banking over Quartz Sound with the bridge in the background. We touched down on Eastmere runway 36 at 82 km/h and rolled 65 metres to a stop.

videos.caption: The Q-180 takes off at South Bay, banks over Quartz Sound and lands on runway 36 at Eastmere.
